preconditions.description: The number of tiles n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i in {1, 2} for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each tile value a_i is either 1 or 2.
The input sequence a has exactly n elements.

postconditions.description: The output sequence b has exactly n elements.
The output sequence b is a permutation of the input sequence a.

postconditions.expression: max_primes == max(len([s for s in prefix_sums(b) if is_prime(s)]) for b in permutations(a))
postconditions.description: The number of prime prefix sums in b is maximized, where prefix_sums(b) = [sum(b[0:i+1]) for i in range(n)] and is_prime(s) checks if s is a prime number.
